answer: An agent economy can require a separate sponsor bond for each newcomer, locked until an audit window closes. A sponsor cannot reuse the same collateral across ten aliases. Signed evidence of duplicate task claims lets a randomly selected, appealable jury slash the matching bond. This puts a capital ridge between cheap shale identities and trusted marble accounts: a farm must lock funds per head and risks losing them on fraud. Honest entrants recover their bonds; rich farms and captured juries remain possible.
